newsitem.title: ITALY: Lira ERM parity will not hurt industry - Prodi.
newsitem.headline: Lira ERM parity will not hurt industry - Prodi.

text.p: The lira's new central ERM parity against the mark of 990 lire will not hurt Italian industry, Prime Minister Romano Prodi said on Monday.
"The figure we settled for is a very well balanced compromise which does not damage Italian industry," Prodi told reporters while attending a business conference in this Northeast Italian city.
"It is only one percent higher than what we asked for," he added.
Italy held out for a 1,000 lire central parity rate but found itself outnumbered by its European Union partners.
"Exchange rates are a means of competition and I am happy that the Italian delegation brought to an almost completely successful conclusion a very hard battle," he added.
Italian industrialists have said they are concerned that the new central parity would blunt their competitive edge.
Prodi said the hard bargaining in Brussels over the weekend by EU finance ministers showed that Italian industrial competition was feared.
